collection.title: Ford Mustang Mustang Coupe 2015 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Mustang Coupe 2015 Onwards version uses a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
